plugins.name: japanlaw
plugins.description: Japanese law, answered from the statute itself: the Japanese as published, the Ministry of Justice's English where there is one and marked machine translation where there is not, every provision quoted with its link. Read-only tools from japanlaw.org's MCP server, and a skill that teaches how a Japanese provision is cited and which English may be quoted.
